nodes.label: ADR-001 Accepted Band-First Planner
nodes.rationale: Point-target locks and unstructured weighted utility can starve package-fit or cooking-batch solutions; the accepted architecture prioritizes hard feasibility, comfort/economics, then human utility.

nodes.label: ADR-002 Accepted Nutrition Policy Engine
nodes.rationale: Nutrients have asymmetric semantics, goal preservation differs from safety, and serving granularity limits achievable precision.

nodes.label: ADR-003 Accepted Orthogonal Plan Policy Resolution
nodes.norm_label: adr-003 accepted orthogonal plan policy resolution
nodes.rationale: A single PlanningMode forces independent preferences into mutually exclusive choices and couples unrelated solver parameters.

nodes.label: ADR-004 Accepted Household-First Model
nodes.rationale: Household ownership avoids future shared-resource migrations while one tracked nutrition member limits V1 solver and UX complexity.

nodes.label: ADR-005 Accepted Grounded Recipe Variants
nodes.rationale: Authored flexibility improves inventory/package fit without allowing the global optimizer to invent invalid recipes.

nodes.label: ADR-006 Accepted Retail Procurement Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Direct SKU optimization is brittle around flash sales and stale availability, but abstraction must retain fulfillment evidence.

nodes.label: ADR-007 Accepted SPEND_LIMIT Robustness
nodes.rationale: Deterministic evidence-derived stress scenarios express correlated procurement risk without claiming an uncalibrated probability.
